style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, high mountain noon
motion_rule: EVERY second something big crosses the lens or fills it: a bill, her tail, the marmot's face, the herd, the paper. Lens fully blanked seven times. The torn banner snaps in the wind all clip
camera_moves: wide; close-ups come from the animals and the paper, not the camera
character: a lean mountain puma on a flat rock, half-closed golden eyes, calm, bills under one paw, an iron chain leash in the other; she never hurries
cast: the MARMOT: fat, chewing without pause, never running, iron collar on his neck. The HERD: goats and deer at full speed, never stopping at the cliff
props: BANNER: a ragged holed cloth strip on two poles over the cliff, flapping hard; painted on it a smiling top-hatted showman and a big cartoon THREE-FINGERED hand making a profit sign. BILLS: pale slips, an embossed percent shape, big as her head. CHAIN: heavy iron, always taut
prop_continuity: the stack shrinks: full at 0.0, half at 4.2, gone at 8.0
environment: sunlit mountain ledge, wind-raked grass, blue sky, dusty valley ending in a sheer drop
lighting: blazing high-altitude noon, hard sun, crisp shadows

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: lazy satisfied female voice, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: pauses only at 1.4-2.2, 3.6-4.2 and 7.0-7.5; the 4.2 and 5.6 lines run together with no breath; voiceless after 8.0
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: cloth cracking in the wind all clip, paper rustle, chain clinking, chewing; at 5.6-7.0 loud bleating and thunder of hooves, going quiet one by one after 8.8

timeline.a: silent. A bill flies INTO THE LENS, blanks the frame, peels away: she is on the rock, the torn banner cracking over the drop
she walks straight at the lens until her face fills the frame, eyes half shut; the banner whips across the top of the frame
silent. She flicks a bill off the stack: it slaps the lens, covers it, drops away; the chain jerks tight across the frame
she turns her whole body on the slab, tail sweeping across the lens; the wind bellies the banner out over the whole frame
silent. The fat MARMOT slams into the lens on his chain, chewing face covering the entire frame, a spray of bills bursting around him
she rises to her feet in one long stretch as the wind tears half the stack into a blizzard over the whole frame
no breath. The herd tears through the frame edge to edge under the banner in a wall of dust, bleating, hooves hammering
silent, the only stop. Nothing moves but the marmot's jaw and the flapping cloth
she whips her head into the lens, muzzle filling the frame, eyes opening wide
silent. She sweeps the rest of the stack over the edge; through the falling paper the herd reaches the drop and the first goats go over
silent. The back rows shove the front ones and the herd pours over the edge one after another; the holed banner smiles over them, the marmot flattens a bill and lies on it

must_appear: the holed banner over the cliff with the smiling showman and the three-fingered profit sign, the chain to the marmot, the herd going over the cliff one after another, back rows shoving front ones
negative_prompt: letters, numbers, cyrillic, words on the banner, subtitles, watermark, night, dusk, dark scene, dim light, live people in the scene, blood, gore, a second puma, slow motion, speed ramp, the herd standing still, the chain breaking, a clean unbroken banner, the puma frozen through a whole beat, silence in the tail, accented Russian, grain
